title: Baba Marta Day - Martenitsa Tradition
description: Baba Marta (Grandma March) is a cherished Ancient Bulgarian spring tradition celebrated on March 1st to welcome spring, departing from winter. People exchange and wear red-and-white yarn tokens called martenitsi for health, strength, and fertility. These are worn until blooming trees or spring birds (storks/swallows) are seen, then tied to trees

title: National Liberation Day - March 3rd 1878
description: Commemorate Treaty of San Stefano (3 March 1878): Russia defeats Ottoman Empire, creates autonomous Bulgarian principality. Biggest national holiday—parades, fireworks, school closures. Celebrated since 1880.
